title: Accounts Payable Analyst
description:
Accounts Payable Analyst Swindon

Opportunity:

Are you currently working in accounts payable dealing with invoices? Does your experience include managing payment controls and dealing with supplier payments? Want to work for a large pharmaceutical manufacturing company? Yes then this is the role for you!

Your role as an Accounts Payable Analyst based in Swindon will involve processing supplier invoices, completing appropriate checks for business approval and/or PO matches and entering the invoice details onto the ERP system.

Duties and responsibilities include:
- Processing supplier invoices with precision, ensuring correct approvals and purchase order matching.
- Entering invoice data into the companies ERP system accurately and efficiently.
- Upholding compliance with internal controls and company payment policies.
- Managing supplier queries, invoice matching, indexing, and coding.

This is a 6 months contract which will be reviewed for a possible extension or go permanent however this is dependent on the candidate and business performance. The PAYE rate is £13.58 per hour.

Skills:

To apply for the Accounts Payable Analyst role you will have the following skills:
- Accounts Payable process experience.
- Working with suppliers.
- Excellent verbal, analytical, inter-personal skills.
- A team player who thrives in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

How to Apply:

To apply for this one off opportunity, please send a word copy of your CV to me now by clicking on the Apply button or call me for a confidential chat. Please ensure you have read and agree to our Privacy Policy which can be found on the Quality Start website.

We also have many incentive schemes for referring contractors/temp staff so please contact us with the referral and we can provide you with more information.

For a list of our current vacancies, please visit the Quality Start website.

title: Customer Service Advisor
description:
Inbound Customer Service Advisor

Swindon Hybrid Working 14.56 per hour 12-Month Contract

Are you someone who enjoys helping people and delivering great customer service? If you're looking for a role where no two calls are the same and every conversation makes a difference, this could be the perfect opportunity for you.

We're recruiting Inbound Customer Service Advisors to join a well-known financial services organisation in Swindon. You'll be the first point of contact for customers, helping them with a range of enquiries and making sure they receive the support they need.

What's the role?

You'll take inbound calls from customers, helping with everything from online banking queries to questions about products and services. No sales targets, just genuinely helping people and finding the right solutions for their needs.

This is a busy role, so you'll need to enjoy speaking to people and be comfortable handling a high volume of calls, typically supporting 40+ customers each day.

Hybrid Working

Once training is complete, you'll work on a hybrid basis with 2 days in the office and 3 days from home.

The first 8 weeks of training are fully office-based in Swindon, Monday to Friday, 9:00am - 5:00pm, giving you all the knowledge and support you need to succeed.

Working Hours
- 14.56 per hour
- Shifts between 8:00am and 8:00pm, Monday to Sunday
- Working 5 days out of 7
- Shift patterns provided in advance
- Typical shift patterns:
- 8:00am - 4:00pm
- 9:00am - 5:00pm
- 10:00am - 6:00pm
- 11:00am - 7:00pm
- 12:00pm - 8:00pm
- If you're on late shifts, you'll have that weekend off

What We're Looking For
- Previous customer service experience
- Confidence speaking with customers over the phone
- Good computer skills and the ability to learn new systems
- Strong attention to detail
- A positive attitude and willingness to help others
- Ability to work in a fast-paced environment
- Access to a reliable and secure internet connection for home working

What's In It For You?
- Full training provided!
- No previous banking or financial services experience required
- Hybrid working after training
- Ongoing support from a friendly and experienced team
- A great opportunity to gain experience within a respected organisation

If you're a people person who enjoys solving problems, building rapport, and making customers feel valued, we'd love to hear from you. Apply today and take the next step in your customer service career.

description:
Job Title: Customer Service Advisor

Location: Swindon, SN25

Pay Rate: £13.00

Shifts: Monday to Friday , 9am 5pm

Gap personnel are currently recruiting for the role of Customer Service Advisor, SN25. The global garden furniture manufacturer is just coming into peak, and us working in partnership are recruiting for additional 2 Customer Service Advisors. Continuous Improvement

title: GP Receptionist
description: The purpose of the Receptionist role is to provide a high-quality, professional reception and administrative service to patients, doctors, staff, colleagues, and other healthcare professionals, portraying the Practice in the highest possible professional manner. Receptionists are responsible for ensuring patients can access the healthcare services they need efficiently and courteously. They play a key role in supporting the day-to-day running of the practice and in ensuring the smooth flow of communication between patients and staff. Flexibility is essential for this role, and you will be required to provide additional cover during staff holidays or sickness. - Ensure an effective and efficient reception service is provided to patients and any other visitors to the practice. - Deal with all general enquiries, explain procedures and make new and follow-up appointments. - Use your own judgment and communication skills. - Explain practice arrangements and formal requirements to new patients and those seeking temporary cover, and ensure procedures are completed. - Receive and make telephone calls as required. Divert calls and take messages, ensuring accuracy of detail and prompt appropriate delivery. - Enter requests for home visits into the clinical system, ensuring to carefully record all relevant details and referring to the rota doctor where necessary. - Enter patient information on to the computer as required. - Open and distribute incoming mail. - Photocopy and shred documentation. - Open up premises at the start of the day when first to arrive, de-activate alarm and make all necessary preparations to receive patients. - When last to leave at the end of the day, ensure that the building is totally secured, internal lights are off and the alarm activated. - Keep the reception area, noticeboards and leaflet dispensers tidy and free from obstructions and clutter. - Assist with the induction of new reception staff. - Support reception team members in managing busy periods and resolving patient queries effectively. - Process new patient registrations and action patient deductions. - Any other delegated duties considered appropriate to the post.
